author: Aerafal
name: D3B Plugin
description: A plugin for D3B: an assembly with a root module, an activity and a page, loaded from the host's plugins folder, that compiles against the D3B.Bot package.

D3BVersion.description: The version of the D3B packages to compile against: the oldest host the plugin runs on.

PluginsDirectory.description: A host's plugins folder. Set it and every build deploys the plugin there; leave it empty and builds do not deploy.

Page.description: Whether the plugin brings a page to the app's rail, an Avalonia control: then it compiles against Avalonia and CommunityToolkit.Mvvm too.
